items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He's a little light guy who looked like (?)Gene Michaels(?)

ctx.x: Yeah, all of them, Gene Michaels(?) and all of them before they come to Harlem. And that's the basics of the thing. So when the Bebop come in, it didn't make too much of a thing with me. You know? I'm not being different. Because I'd heard Clarence Profit makin' them progressions. Because Edgar Sampson had taken "Stompin' at The Savoy" from Clarence Profit. But Clarence Profit was a little cat, didn't say nothin'.
